methodologyNotes: Products selected as notable 2022-2025 mechanical keyboards buyers commonly compare in 2026. Specs and prices sourced from manufacturer product pages (Keychron .json API, NuPhy product pages, Razer store, Logitech G store, Corsair store listing), corroborated by independent reviews (thegamingsetup.com for ROG Azoth and GMMK Pro). Razer Huntsman V3 Pro price from razer.com/gaming-keyboards at $209.99 current (MSRP listed $249.99 at launch). Corsair K70 MAX price $249.99 from corsair.com product listing (2025 updated model with adjustable MGX switches); the original 2022 CH-9109414-NA model was $179.99 MSRP. Logitech G Pro X TKL Lightspeed $219.99 from logitechg.com LIGHTSPEED product page. Keychron prices from product JSON APIs (current pricing as of access date). GMMK Pro $170 barebones from thegamingsetup.com review (July 2021 release; note product may be discontinued from Glorious website as of 2026). NuPhy prices from nuphy.com product pages. priceUsd represents the US starting/base price for the base or most common config. Keychron K2 v2 uses Bluetooth 3.0 (older design); K8 Pro and Q1 Pro use Bluetooth 5.1. Hot-swap on Logitech G Pro X TKL: not confirmed hot-swappable (traditional plate-mounted). accessedAt=2026-06-15.
